description: Polymer web component behavior for multi-selectable elements, defining properties, methods, and behaviors for handling multiple selections in a Polymer-based UI component.

classes.name: Polymer.IronMultiSelectableBehavior
classes.description: Behavior combining IronSelectableBehavior with multi-select capabilities, including properties and methods for managing multiple selections.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects a value; toggles selection if multi is true, otherwise sets the selected value.

methods.name: multiChanged
methods.description: Observer that updates the multi property in the selection object.

methods.name: _updateSelected
methods.description: Updates the selection state based on current properties.

methods.name: _selectMulti
methods.description: Selects multiple values by updating the internal selection.

methods.name: _selectionChange
methods.description: Handles changes in selection, updating selected items and current selection.

methods.name: _toggleSelected
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of a given value.
